SELECT c.id, c.content, c.created_at AS createTime, c.like_count AS likeCount, c.reply_count AS replyCount, c.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS userName, u.avatar AS userAvatar, c.manuscript_id AS manuscriptId, m.title AS manuscriptTitle, m.cover_url AS manuscriptCover FROM comments c INNER JOIN manuscripts m ON c.manuscript_id = m.id INNER JOIN users u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE m.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id AS manuscriptId, title, cover_url AS coverUrl, view_count AS viewCount, like_count AS likeCount, comment_count AS commentCount, coin_count AS coinCount, collect_count AS collectCount, share_count AS shareCount, upload_time AS uploadTime FROM manuscripts WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY view_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id AS manuscriptId, title, cover_url AS coverUrl, view_count AS viewCount, like_count AS likeCount, comment_count AS commentCount, coin_count AS coinCount, collect_count AS collectCount, share_count AS shareCount, upload_time AS uploadTime, CASE WHEN view_count > 0 THEN (like_count + comment_count + coin_count + collect_count + share_count) * 1.0 / view_count ELSE 0 END AS interactionRate FROM manuscripts WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY (like_count + comment_count + coin_count + collect_count + share_count) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
